official: 横浜市一時保護施設の設備及び運営の基準に関する条例及び横浜市児童福祉施設の設備及び運営の基準に関する条例の一部改正

sources.label: 議案一覧（令和8年第1回定例会）

name: 一時保護施設などの職員資格を見直す
summary: 条例では、一時保護施設や児童福祉施設で働く職種ごとに資格要件を定めています。この議案は、複数の職種の資格に「こども家庭ソーシャルワーカー」を加えるほか、一部の職種の要件を改めます。改正は2026年3月1日に施行されます。
changes: 一時保護施設の児童指導員の資格にこども家庭ソーシャルワーカーを加える
児童福祉施設の複数の職種の資格にこども家庭ソーシャルワーカーを加える
児童自立支援専門員と児童生活支援員の資格に精神保健福祉士を加える
乳児院と児童養護施設の家庭支援専門相談員の資格要件から社会福祉士と精神保健福祉士を外す
who: 一時保護施設や児童福祉施設の職員・運営者
why: 一時保護施設と児童福祉施設の設備・運営に関する基準の改正に伴い、資格を追加するなどのためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Reviews qualifications for staff at temporary protection facilities and other facilities
en.official: Partial Amendment to the Yokohama City Ordinance on Standards for Equipment and Operation of Temporary Protection Facilities and the Yokohama City Ordinance on Standards for Equipment and Operation of Child Welfare Facilities
en.summary: The ordinances set qualification requirements for each type of job at temporary protection facilities and child welfare facilities. This bill adds the Children and Families Social Worker qualification for several job types and revises requirements for some other job types. The amendments take effect on March 1, 2026.
changes: Add the Children and Families Social Worker qualification for child guidance workers at temporary protection facilities
Add the Children and Families Social Worker qualification for several job types at child welfare facilities
Add the mental health social worker qualification for child independence support specialists and child life support workers
Remove social worker and mental health social worker qualifications from the requirements for family support specialist counselors at infant homes and children's homes
who: Staff and operators of temporary protection facilities and child welfare facilities
en.why: The city says the changes, including adding qualifications, are being made in response to revisions to the standards for the equipment and operation of temporary protection facilities and child welfare facilities.
